title: Real camouflage on soldiers, bases and nets
summary: Uniforms are printed in proper camouflage patterns, base buildings are painted in disruptive blotches, and camouflage nets look like cut garnish on a cord mesh.
rationale: An appearance change: matched before/after stills of the same men, buildings and nets show it best.
source_ref: Before: eb81260e. After: this branch. Soldiers: --soldier-sheet --sheet-unit=fighter --sheet-seeds=6 --sheet-pose=idle at 1600x900. Base: --scenario=showroom --shot-at=6 --focus=-12,-22 --zoom=30 --pitch=-28 --cam-yaw=0.4 --set=dof:false --nohud --perf=0. Nets: photo mode, --scenario=showroom --static --photo-at=4 --focus=42,-34 --zoom=10 --cam-yaw=0.5 --photo=blur:0,fov:45,aim:14:5.0 and --scenario=cache --static --photo-at=3 --focus=-6,-22 --zoom=10 --cam-yaw=0.5 --photo=blur:0,fov:40,aim:10:3.0, cropped clear of the photo panel. Forward+, off-screen windowed runs on Windows.
